description: Investigating Drought–Seismicity Linkages Across Botswana and surrounding areas: Evidence from SPEI and Earthquake Catalogues is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset integrates climate and seismic records to investigate potential linkages between drought variability and earthquake occurrence across Botswana and its surrounding areas, with particular emphasis on the Okavango Rift Zone. Coverage: Botswana. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Seismology, Climate Change, Computational Seismology. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
